messages:
ravi.sdk: Quick PSA — new user reported TS errors when using the JS SDK in Cloudflare worker sample. Error mentions overload mismatch and 'unknown' leaking into prompt.

mei.types: can you paste the compiler output?

ravi.sdk: sure: 
```
src/index.ts:5:12 - error TS2769: No overload matches this call.
5 const out = Redwood.complete({ prompt: userInput });
             ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
src/types.d.ts:30:10 - error TS2345: Argument of type 'unknown' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'.
```

jordan.build: sample uses `moduleResolution: 'bundler'` and `type: 'module'`. Locally with `nodenext` it compiled fine. Edge bundlers behave differently.

mei.types: sounds like our overloads are too permissive. We have `complete(prompt: string)` and `complete<T>(input: T): Promise<T | any>`. When input is `unknown`, TS can't choose the string overload and falls to the generic which expects T leading to the error.

lee.runtime: runtime note: some edge packs will resolve to the CJS entry if both exist which changes the TS shape. Bundlers + `exports` map combos are the culprit.

ravi.sdk: short-term fix for the sample: update import to `import * as Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` or explicitly annotate generics `Redwood.complete<string>({ prompt: userInput })`. Both unblock.

mei.types: long-term fixes: 1) narrow generic to `T extends Record<string, unknown>` so `unknown` doesn't match, 2) publish cjs/esm shims so bundlers pick intended entry, 3) add `tsc --noEmit` jobs in sample CI for both `bundler` and `nodenext`.

jordan.build: I will patch the sample README with the import workaround and add a CI compile matrix.

ci-bot: queued: ci/sample-compile-matrix (bundler,nodenext) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mei.types: I'll open a typings PR to tighten overloads and run the SDK e2e compile checks.

lee.runtime: I'll prototype a packaging shim to ensure consumers get a deterministic entry for edge builds.

ravi.sdk: thanks all. marking this as blocker for the onboarding sample until docs + small patch are in.
